feature.title: Promo Suggestions (Next Best Slab)
feature.contentMd:
## What It Does
During order discount calculation, detects if the order is close to unlocking a better promotional slab. Generates a suggestion message showing exactly how much more is needed to qualify for a better deal.

Shown as a toast notification on the order summary page. This is an order-level feature, not user-specific.

## Common Questions
- **Can the system suggest to buy more to get a better deal?** Yes — Promo Suggestions detect when an order is close to a higher discount tier and show a message like 'Add 3 more cases to jump from 5% to 10% off'.
- **How does the system know when to show a suggestion?** A configurable threshold percentage determines how close the order must be to the next tier. If the order is within that threshold, a suggestion appears.
- **Can suggestions show in different languages?** Yes — message templates support multiple languages (English, Hindi, Bahasa, etc.).
- **Does tapping the suggestion auto-add items?** No — the suggestion is informational only. The user decides whether to add more items.

## Scope
### In Scope
- Threshold mode suggestions (almost qualifying)
- Better slab mode suggestions (upgrade to next tier)
- Multi-language message templates
- Per-promo threshold configuration

### Out of Scope
- Actual discount calculation (covered in Automatic Discount)
- Order modification by suggestion (informational only)

## Who Uses It
- **Salesperson / Retailer / Distributor** — sees the suggestion toast and can act on it
- **Trade Marketing** — configures threshold percentage per promo

## Rules
1. Two modes: Threshold (almost qualifying) and Better Slab (upgrade opportunity)
2. Per-promo and global thresholds both configurable
3. Supports amount (₹) and quantity (pieces, cases) suggestions
4. Multi-language messages (English, Hindi, Bahasa, etc.)
5. Per-promo — if multiple promos have suggestions, all are shown

## Data & Fields
| Field | Description | Required | Example |
|-------|-------------|----------|--------|
| Current Quantity | Items already in order | Yes | 85 cases |
| Slab Start | Target slab minimum | Yes | 100 cases |
| Gap | Remaining to qualify | Yes | 15 cases |
| Current Benefit | Current slab benefit | No | 5% |
| Next Benefit | Next slab benefit | No | 10% |
| Message Template | Localized suggestion text | No | Add {gap} more to get {benefit} |

## Tenant-Level Configurations
| Config Point | Options | Default | Example |
|-------------|---------|---------|--------|
| Global suggestion toggle | ON/OFF | ON | Enable/disable suggestions globally |
| Per-promo threshold % | 0-100 | 20 | Show if within 20% of next slab |
| Message templates | Per language | English | Hindi, Bahasa, English templates |

scenarios.title: Threshold Mode — Almost Qualifying for a Slab
scenarios.contentMd:
## Common Questions
- **How close does an order need to be for a suggestion to appear?** It depends on the threshold configured for the promo. For example, a 20% threshold on a 100-case slab means suggestions appear from 80 cases onwards.

## What It Does
When an order does NOT qualify for any slab but is close (within a configured threshold percentage), the system shows a suggestion: 'Add X more to qualify for this discount.'

## Example
- A promo has Slab 1: Buy 100+ cases → 5% off
- The promo creator sets a threshold of 20% (meaning suggestions show when the order is within 20% of the slab)
- 20% of 100 = 20, so the threshold zone is 80-99 cases
- A salesperson adds 85 cases to the order
- 85 is within the threshold zone (80-99) → a suggestion appears:
  - Toast: **'Add 15 more cases to unlock 5% off on this order!'**
- If the salesperson only had 70 cases, no suggestion would appear (70 is below the 80-case threshold zone)

## How the Threshold Percentage Works
- Threshold = 20% means: suggest if order quantity ≥ (slab start × 80%)
- For a 100-case slab at 20% threshold → suggest from 80 cases onwards
- For a 50-case slab at 20% threshold → suggest from 40 cases onwards
- The threshold is configurable per promo by the creator

## Rules
1. The order does NOT currently qualify for any slab — it's below the first slab's start range
2. But the order is within the threshold zone — close enough to be worth suggesting
3. The system calculates the exact remaining quantity or amount needed
4. Suggestion is informational only — tapping the toast does NOT auto-add items to the order
5. The threshold percentage is set by the promo creator during promo setup

scenarios.title: Better Slab Mode — Upgrade to Next Tier
scenarios.contentMd:
## Common Questions
- **If I already have a discount, can the system tell me how to get a bigger one?** Yes — Better Slab mode detects when you're close to the next tier and shows exactly how much more is needed.

## What It Does
When an order already qualifies for a slab but is close to the NEXT higher slab, the system suggests upgrading: 'Add X more to jump from Y% to Z% off.'

## Example
- A promo has: Slab 1 (10-20 cases → 5% off), Slab 2 (21-50 cases → 10% off)
- A salesperson orders 18 cases → qualifies for Slab 1 (5% off)
- 18 cases is close to Slab 2's start (21 cases) — only 3 more cases needed
- Toast appears: **'Add just 3 more cases to jump from 5% to 10% off!'**
- The salesperson considers: adding 3 cases doubles the discount from 5% to 10% on the entire order

## Example with Amount-Based Slabs
- A promo has: Slab 1 (₹5,000-₹9,999 → ₹200 off), Slab 2 (₹10,000+ → ₹500 off)
- An order totals ₹9,200 → qualifies for Slab 1 (₹200 off)
- Toast: **'Add ₹800 more to your order to get ₹500 off instead of ₹200!'**
- The customer sees: ₹800 more in purchases gives them ₹300 more in discount

## Why This Matters
Promo suggestions help increase average order value. By showing the user exactly how close they are to a better deal, the system encourages them to add more items — benefiting both the retailer (more stock) and the company (higher sales volume).

## Rules
1. The order already qualifies for a slab but is close to the next higher slab
2. The system shows the benefit difference between current and next slab
3. Near-to-slab threshold is configurable at the promo level
4. Works with both amount-based (₹) and quantity-based (pieces, cases) slabs
5. Multiple suggestions can appear simultaneously if multiple promos have upgrade opportunities
